title: Scalar evaluation of the normalized right projection mate
statement: Fix a prime l, coefficient option c, and Λ=(coefficient l c).X as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category]. Let Y be a scheme, P its projective line, and q:P→Y. Write F=q* and R=Rq_* on the fixed derived module categories, λ for projectionMateMap of [def-sfb-tate-twisted-projection-comparison], and η:F(1_Y)→1_P for secondTraceUnitIso of [def-sfb-rational-p1-second-pretrace-data]. Choose M in D(Mod Λ_P), K,S,T in D(Mod Λ_Y), arrows A:S→T and B:T→RM tensor K, objects V,W in D(Mod Λ_P), and arrows b:FK→V, v:V→W, w:W→1_P, t:K→1_Y satisfying b v w = F(t) η. Then A B λ(M,K) R(M tensor b) R((M tensor v)(M tensor w)ρ_M) = A B (RM tensor t)ρ_RM. The two direct-image factors on the left remain separate. No trace, line, Reference, base-field or invertibility hypothesis is used.

proof.text: Tensor the assumed scalar square b ≫ v ≫ w = Fq.map t ≫ u with M, postcompose by its right unitor, and combine whiskerings. Functoriality transports this replacement through Rq. This is purely formal and uses no diagram or trace.
The normalization in projectionMate_existsUnique identifies the fixed projectionMateMap pointwise with the native counit mate. Reduce the fixed tensor bundle to the native tensor for this comparison.

Write λ_K for the right projection mate. Its naturality gives λ_K Rq_*(1_M tensor q*t) = (1_Rq_*M tensor t) λ_1. At the unit, transpose λ_1 followed by Rq_* of tensoring with the oplax unit and the right unitor through the derived adjunction. The transpose definition is the pullback tensor comparison followed by the counit. Oplax right-unitality, counit naturality and the adjunction triangle reduce this transpose to that of the right unitor of Rq_*M. Injectivity of the adjunction hom-equivalence gives λ_1 Rq_*(evaluation at the unit) = ρ_Rq_*M. Combine with the naturality equation and functoriality. This is also precisely the fully proved generic rightAdjointProjectionMap_rightUnitality calculation.

The original derived oplax unit is leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso.hom. The strong monoidal structure is made from its inverse as the lax unit; hence its inverse unit, cached as secondTraceUnitIso, is the same original map. Transfer along the pointwise projection normalization and the fixed tensor bundle. This yields the literal displayed equation, with no trace inserted.
Use functoriality to write the scalar evaluation as the two prescribed direct-image factors and precompose both sides by A and B.

lean.statement:
theorem projectionMate_scalar_evaluation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (M : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y))
    (S T : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y))
    (A : S ⟶ T)
    (B : T ⟶ (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M ⊗ K)
    (V W : DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    (b : (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj K ⟶ V)
    (v : V ⟶ W) (w : W ⟶ 𝟙_ (DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y))))
    (t : K ⟶ 𝟙_ (DerivedCategory (Modules (coefficient l c).X Y)))
    (ht : b ≫ v ≫ w =
      (moduleObjectDerivedPullback (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map t ≫
        (secondTraceUnitIso (coefficient l c).X Y).hom) :
    A ≫ B ≫ projectionMateMap (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) M K ≫
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map (M ◁ b) ≫
      (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).map
        ((M ◁ v) ≫ (M ◁ w) ≫ (ρ_ M).hom) =
      A ≫ B ≫ ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M ◁
      t) ≫
        (ρ_ ((moduleObjectDerivedPushforward (coefficient l c).X (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)).obj M)).hom
